sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 10207879, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: recreation.gov rate table, 2027 season (effective 2026-04-21): nonelectric site $20, electric site $36 a night; the camping fee covers 2 vehicles. Dump station $10 for non-campers (free for paid campers).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207879/rates (2027 Peak Season: 'Nonelectric Site' 20, 'Electic Site' 36, 'Dump Station' 10) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207879 ('Camping fee covers 2 vehicles maximum'; 'Dump Station free for paid campers'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 10207879 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20): 5 of 31 public sites STANDARD ELECTRIC with Electricity Hookup 30; every site Water Hookup 'No'; no sewer attribute

values.note: 31 campsites (26 nonelectric, 5 with 30-amp electric); recreation.gov lists driveway lengths of 20 to 84 ft. 'Tents and travel trailers are welcome.'

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207879 ('31 Campsites') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/fore-lake-campground ('With 31 sites tucked in the shade of oaks and pines') + RIDB catalog (Driveway Length per site), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207879 ('Bathhouse with showers and flush toilets'; 'Dump Station free for paid campers'; amenities 'Drinking Water') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/fore-lake-campground (Amenities: 'Drinking water', 'Dump station', 'Showers with hot water'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14-day limit in any 30-day period in all Ocala National Forest campgrounds. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am; the main entrance gate is open 8 am to 8 pm. Sites may close when capacity is reached.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207879 ('14 day stay limit in a 30 day period in ALL Ocala National Forest Campgrounds'; notices 'Main entrance gate opens from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.', 'Check in- 3 p.m. Check out- 11 a.m.'; all 31 public sites reservable in the catalog) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/fore-lake-campground ('Maximum stay limit of 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov and the USFS page: $20 nonelectric / $36 electric (2027 rates), 30-amp electric at 5 sites and no water hookups (catalog), 31 sites, showers/flush toilets/drinking water/dump, reservable on recreation.gov, 14-night limit. Not stated: season, booking window, minimum stay (no rec.gov min-stay rules), pull-throughs, max rig length (only driveway lengths). The USFS page's template lines 'Potable water is not available' and 'Restroom information is not available' contradict its own amenity list and recreation.gov; recorded potable_water from the amenity lists. Note kept (AWH firsthand).
